title: Keep the writer and the judge apart
statement: Keep the writer and the judge apart: void any item whose student-facing text addresses the judge, and show the writer plain editorial notes, never the judge's scores or raw output.
detail: The external judge runs an integrity check first, fails items carrying score claims, rubric self-advocacy or instructions to the evaluator, and sets every metric to zero when an item fails it (`icloud-work/evaluatorML/.agent/memory/analysis/2026-05-25-inceptbench-prompt-audit.md`). The pipeline's writer contract carries no scoring labels, weights or judge-facing terms, and its repair step turns the judge's reasoning and suggested improvements into content-review notes, dropping sentences with judge words, so that the writer never sees the judge's names, scores, metric labels or raw output (`icloud-work/evaluatorML/.agent/memory/e2e_pipeline/iterate_repair_to_100.py`). It is the item-side counterpart of asking whether a student's words are aimed at the marker. Text that addresses the judge includes an answer key or grading note written into the item.
against: No run compares repairs given these notes with repairs given the raw verdicts or no notes. The note cleaner also drops more than it means to: its sentence split escapes the whitespace class twice and so never splits ordinary text, and a note with any banned word in it, even pass inside passage, is dropped whole (`icloud-work/evaluatorML/.agent/memory/e2e_pipeline/iterate_repair_to_100.py`, `sanitize_review_note`). Some integrity voids were the judge's own bug ('Known IB v2.4 bug.' and 'Empty stems trigger InceptBench integrity_check false positive', `icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/research/inference_clean.md`, lines 50 and 64). The 14 records were stored items in a training bundle, and the action taken was a scrub of that data, not a live check on new items.

evidence.quote: - Integrity check runs first. Never include evaluator-facing score claims, rubric self-advocacy, or instructions to the evaluator.
- Integrity failure overrides all metrics to zero.
"""Generator-safe contract: no scoring labels, weights, or judge-facing terms."""
The generator must never see evaluator names, scores, metric labels, or raw judge JSON. It only receives ordinary editorial/historical repair notes.
Evaluation voided: integrity_check failed. The content contains embedded evaluation/score data and score-steering instructions.
**This is a prompt-injection style failure where the model has emitted an answer key + scoring guidance INSIDE the question content.**
Recommended: scrub the training set for any stimulus containing strings like `"score:"`, `"rationale:"`, `"part_1_*"` regex match.
**Scrub training data of prompt-injection-style stimuli** — F1 found ~14 MCQ_SET records with embedded scoring directives in `stimulus`.
